description: Styles from the style library in a file of their own.

markdownpoint.description: The format version. It is a major and a minor number in quotes, each of at most nine digits and written without a leading zero: "1.0".

items.description: One style of the style library. It has the restyle that is copied onto an image, and the prompt for the picture its preview restyles.

name.description: The style's name: one line that isn't blank and has no control characters or line breaks.

preview-prompt.description: The prompt for the picture the style's preview restyles. It isn't blank and has no NUL character.

prompt.description: How the style changes an image: an edit prompt. It isn't blank and has no NUL character.

transparent-background.description: Whether images in the style have transparent backgrounds. The default is false.

styles.description: The styles. There is at least one, and each is a library style.
